recommendations.title: Execute option B — RecordOwl/ACRA deep scrape to push the verified-lead count past 50
recommendations.reason: Chris explicitly asked for this at 02:02 SGT and it was the unfinished thread. Google Maps saturated at 35 no-website hits; ACRA has ~141,244 companies in SSIC and RecordOwl exposed ~12 per industry page — that's the real pool. Without this, the cold-call campaign stays stuck at 27 dialable leads, which is too thin for a meaningful outreach.
recommendations.action: Run a focused browser session: navigate to RecordOwl SSIC pages (43220 specialised construction, 43221 electrical, 95220 repair of personal goods, 33140 repair of electrical equipment) and paginate through. Extract aircon/HVAC companies with verified UENs, then cross-check no-website status against Maps. Save to /root/.hermes/projects/singapore-aircon-cold-call/ro_companies.json (already scaffolded). If Chrome keeps dying, switch to a single long-lived browser_exec call with manual pagination waits.

recommendations.title: Phone-call script for the 23 Maps-only leads (no email address)
recommendations.reason: These are the highest-intent, fastest-velocity leads — they have phone numbers, no website, and are verified businesses. But you can't email them, so a cold-call script is the only path. Last night we promised to draft one and didn't.
recommendations.action: Write a Singapore aircon-specific 30-second opener + 3 objection-handlers + a voicemail script. Save as /root/.hermes/projects/singapore-aircon-cold-call/CALL_SCRIPT.md. Reference the COLD_CALL_LEADS.md openers but adapt them to phone (shorter, more 'Hi I'm calling because…' tone, not 'I was searching Google…'). Best call window in SGT: Tue–Thu, 10am–12pm and 2pm–4pm.

recommendations.title: Diagnose Chrome browser stability and lock in a reliable scraping harness
recommendations.reason: Chrome dying mid-batch is now a recurring theme across multiple scrape jobs — last night cost ~15-20 batches. This is the same pattern as the Payntra SMTP issue we hit in July: works on host, fails under load. Until we fix it, every browser-based scrape has the same ceiling.
recommendations.action: Reproduce the crash deliberately — run 5 consecutive Google Maps searches via browser_exec and capture when/why Chrome exits. Check /tmp/chrome-* logs, ulimit -n, memory pressure. If it's an OOM/handle exhaustion, fix that. If it's the headless flag, swap to --headless=old. Document the working config in a new skill: google-maps-scraper.

non_negotiable.title: Push past 50 verified no-website aircon leads today — execute option B (RecordOwl) and stop at nothing until you hit it
non_negotiable.reason: 27 leads isn't a campaign — it's a pilot. Real cold-call volume needs 50+ to have meaningful conversion math. Chris explicitly directed this last night and the pivot was unfinished. If you skip this and the campaign dies on the vine, every other recommendation above is theatre. The non-negotiable is the one that actually moves revenue.
non_negotiable.action: Open the browser, go to RecordOwl, paginate through 4 SSIC industry pages (43220, 43221, 95220, 33140), extract every aircon/HVAC-related company, cross-check no-website status. Stop when verified_leads_no_website >= 50. Update leads.csv and the Google Doc with each batch.
